q: If I ____ a computer I would type myself.
No sooner _____________ than the fire alarm went off.
If the streets would have been clearly marked it would not have taken us so long to find his house .
o: so long to find his house
e: ভুলটি "would have" অংশে: if-clause-এ would have বসে না, সঠিক রূপ "If the streets had been clearly marked"। এটি third conditional, যার গঠন If + past perfect, subject + would have + past participle, অর্থাৎ অতীতের অবাস্তব শর্ত বোঝায়। ফলাফলের অংশে "it would not have taken us" ঠিক আছে, তাই "would not have" ভুল নয়। "clearly" adverb হিসেবে marked-কে বিশেষিত করছে, আর "so long to find his house" অংশটিও শুদ্ধ। উদাহরণ: "If you had come earlier, you would have met him."

q: তখন যদি তুমি আমায় বলতে, তাহলে আমি তোমার জন্য অনেক কিছু করতে পারতাম। (Translate into English)
o: If you told me then, I could do a lot for you.
If you had told me then, I would have done a lot for you.
If you had told me then, I could have done a lot for you.
If you had told me then, I could do a lot for you.

q: No sooner had I seen Rumi ____________.
Which of the following sentences is correct?
o: She left the house early, lest she might missed the important meeting.
She left the house early, lest she might miss the important meeting.
She left the house early, lest she might be miss the important meeting.
She left the house early, lest she might misses the important meeting.
e: Lest-এর অর্থ যাতে না ঘটে বা এই আশঙ্কায়, আর এটি নিজেই না-বোধক, তাই এর পরে আর not বসে না। Lest-এর পর subject-এর সাথে should বা might এবং তারপর verb-এর base form আসে। তাই lest she might miss the important meeting শুদ্ধ। উদাহরণ: They whispered their plans, lest their competitors should discover their strategy। অন্য অপশনে might-এর পর misses, be miss বা missed আছে, যা ভুল।

q: She dances as if she _______ the only one in the room.
Choose the correct sentence.
o: No sooner he had entered the room than the light went out and everyone started talking loudly.
No sooner had he entered the room than the light went out and everyone started talking loudly.
No sooner had he entered the room when the light went out and everyone started talking loudly.
No sooner he had entered the room then the light went out and everyone started talking loudly.
e: No sooner দিয়ে বাক্য শুরু হলে Inversion হয়, অর্থাৎ auxiliary verb subject-এর আগে বসে (No sooner had he entered)। প্রথম clause-এর পরে দ্বিতীয় clause শুরু হয় than দিয়ে, when বা then দিয়ে নয়। কাঠামো: Negative adverb + auxiliary + subject + main verb। অন্য এ ধরনের শব্দ: hardly, scarcely, rarely, barely, never, not until। যেমন: Never have we witnessed such cruel behavior। তাই সঠিক বাক্যে had he এবং than দুটোই আছে।

q: Choose the correct sentence.
o: If he taken the opportunity, he would have won the competition.
If he had taken the opportunity, he would have won the competition.
If he had taken the opportunity, he have won the competition.
If he had taken the opportunity, he would had won the competition.
e: অতীতের অবাস্তব শর্ত Third Conditional দিয়ে প্রকাশ হয়। গঠন: If + had + V3, subject + would/could/might + have + V3। তাই If he had taken the opportunity, he would have won the competition শুদ্ধ। would had বা have won এই গঠনে ভুল, আর শর্তের অংশে had ছাড়া taken চলে না।

q: Had I known you were waiting outside, _____ .
o: I have invited you to come in.
I had invited you to come in.
I would have invited you to come in.
I would had invited you to come in.
e: Had দিয়ে শুরু হওয়া শর্তের অংশ Third Conditional-এর বিকল্প রূপ; এটি If I had known-এর সমতুল্য। এর পর মূল clause-এ would/could/might + have + past participle বসে। তাই I would have invited you to come in শুদ্ধ। অর্থ: তুমি বাইরে অপেক্ষা করছ জানলে ভেতরে আসতে বলতাম। would had বা have invited এই গঠনে ভুল।

q: She behaves as if she ___ the whole office, though in fact she does not.
Fill in the Blank: If I _____ you, I would return the money.
If I had more free time, I would _____ a new language.
No sooner had I turned on the TV than the news ______.
If only you _____ to the meeting!
Identify the correct sentence.
o: If I had more time, I may learn to play the guitar.
If I had more time, I could have learn to play the guitar.
If I had more time, I might learn to play the guitar.
If I had more time, I would have learnt to play the guitar.

q: Choose the incorrect sentence.
o: We urge that he leave now.
We urge that he leaves now.
e: Urge, demand, insist, suggest, propose, require, request-এর মতো ক্রিয়ার পর that দিয়ে clause এলে সেখানে Subjunctive mood হয়, অর্থাৎ verb-এর base form বসে, কর্তা যে-ই হোক। তাই We urge that he leave now শুদ্ধ, আর leaves বসানো বাক্য ভুল। উদাহরণ: The judge insisted that the jury return a verdict; The doctor suggested that he not smoke। that না থাকলে infinitive আসে, যেমন We urge him to leave। তাই ভুল বাক্যটি হলো প্রথমটি।

q: No sooner had he __________ police than he ______ away.
